about: Sangoma Technologies Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, distributes, and supports voice and data connectivity components for software-based communication applications in the United States of America and internationally. It offers communications platforms comprising pure cloud and hybrid unified communications as a service, and on-premises systems; retail and wholesale SIP trunking, as well as fax as a service. The company also provides Communications Platform as a Service, builds services and applications using real-time communication features, such as voice, video, chat, and SMS, via the cloud; Sangoma Meet, a cloud-based service accessible from any device; and Sangoma TeamHub, a softphone client software application. It also provides managed service providers, including managed security, managed SD-WAN, and managed access, as well as network interconnection and open-source software products. Sangoma Technologies Corporation is headquartered in Sarasota, Florida.
